title: plugin-view: `Record<ViewType, …>` is missing the `chart` key — chart view has no label or icon
body:
Found by the full type-check sweep in #2911 / #2915. `@object-ui/plugin-view` had **no type-check script**, so this was invisible to CI.

## The errors

```
packages/plugin-view/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx(57,7): error TS2741:
  Property 'chart' is missing in type '{ list: string; detail: string; grid: string;
  kanban: string; calendar: string; timeline: string; map: string; gallery: string;
  gantt: string; tree: string; }' but required in type 'Record<ViewType, string>'.

packages/plugin-view/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx(70,7): error TS2741:
  Property 'chart' is missing in type '{ list: ...; ... 7 more ...; tree: ... }'
  but required in type 'Record<ViewType, LucideIcon>'.
```

Two exhaustive maps keyed by `ViewType` — one of labels, one of Lucide icons — are each missing the `chart` entry. `chart` is a member of `ViewType`, and `plugin-charts` is a registered view, so this is a **user-visible gap**: the chart view renders in the switcher with no label and no icon.

There is also a third, separate error in the same package:

```
packages/plugin-view/src/ViewTabBar.tsx(234,43): error TS2322:
  Type 'SyntheticListenerMap | undefined' is not assignable to
  type 'Record<string, (...args: any[]) => void> | undefined'.
```

(dnd-kit listener type, unrelated to the `chart` gap.)

## Why it needs a decision, not just a compile fix

Silencing the type error is one line, but picking the label and icon is a product call — what the chart view is called in each locale, and which Lucide glyph represents it. Worth confirming against whatever `plugin-charts` already shows elsewhere so the switcher does not disagree with the rest of the UI.

## Reproducing

`plugin-view` has no `type-check` script yet, so add the `paths` override its type-checked peers carry, then:

```
cd packages/plugin-view && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit
```

Without the `paths` override you also get ~104 TS6059 `rootDir` errors, which are tsconfig shape rather than source bugs — see #2915 for the mechanism.

## Closing this out

`@object-ui/plugin-view` is listed in `DEBT` in `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` with `errors: 3`. When these are fixed, add `"type-check": "tsc --noEmit"` and **delete the DEBT entry** — the guard fails if an entry outlives its gap.

Refs #2911, #2915
